The harbour master kept a ledger of every ship that entered the bay, and the Plain anchor text led to the office where the ledgers were stored for public reading on weekdays, long after the harbour itself had closed to traffic.

A second clerk added notes in the margin of each page, citing the Titled anchor text as the source for every arrival recorded during the busiest decade of the port.

The full catalogue is published at https://example.com/catalogue and is updated whenever a new volume of the ledger is transcribed by the volunteers.

A photograph of the harbour hangs in the reading room: and a decorative divider follows it before the caption that names the photographer.

The museum logo links to its home page: and visitors are asked to follow it for opening hours and directions to the harbour.
